item.title: living on borrowed time
item.description:
what we borrow from today, we owe to tomorrow. and the longer we keep borrowing, the heavier the bill becomes.

sometimes we borrow consciously. sometimes we don’t even realize we’re doing it.

push things off. delay the effort. delay the discomfort. delay the cost.

miss a few hours of sleep, you feel it the next day. miss it consistently, and it compounds. slowly, quietly, until it doesn’t feel small anymore.

item.title: how to run a marathon
item.description:
we’re all aware that life is a marathon, not a sprint. but how do you run a marathon? how do you make it enjoyable, instead of miserable? how do you make it so that you look forward to the marathon of life instead of dreading it?

it’s very simple: no matter what happens, you don’t look up.

keep your head down. focus on one step at a time. give each step the attention, focus and respect it deserves. but once you’ve taken that step, forget about it. be present in each and every moment. don’t dwell in the past. don’t worry about the future and the journey ahead. remember: one step at a time.

item.title: on being successful
item.description:
to understand what it means to be successful in life, it is important we first understand success itself.

simply put: success is the accomplishment of a goal.

therefore statistically speaking, to lead a successful life would mean to achieve >50% of our goals. in other words, accomplishing more goals than we fall short of during the course of our lives.

so does success look the same for everyone? yes. like we stated earlier, it is the accomplishment of a goal.

item.title: aren't we all "on a diet"?
item.description:
some of us on one meal a day. some on low-carb. some on keto. the list goes on… and some (read most) of us are on a eat-whatever-you-want diet. a go-with-the-flow diet.

being intentional, deliberate and purposeful versus being unplanned and carefree.

if we sat in a car and started driving with no destination in mind, the odds of us arriving at a nice place are very slim and we’re more likely to end up somewhere we don’t like.
